control_flow_unreachable_code.description: Code after continue/return statements becomes unreachable
detection: Look for continue/return followed by non-comment code
Check if critical logic comes after early exit statements
prevention: Put all processing logic INSIDE condition blocks
Never place code after continue/return in same block
Use code linters to detect unreachable code

column_index_mismatch.description: Hardcoded column letters don't match actual sheet header structure
detection: Compare hardcoded column letters (P, Q, R) with header structure
Verify initialize_sheet() headers match all update_cell() calls
Check for column letter mismatches across multiple files
prevention: Never hardcode column letters - always derive from headers
Use column name constants instead of letters
Verify column mappings match between initialize_sheet() and all update operations

examples.good:
col_idx = headers.index('Contacted?')
col_letter = chr(65 + col_idx)
sheets.update_cell(f'{col_letter}{i}', 'Yes', tab_name)

inconsistent_column_references.description: Different files use different column letters for the same data
detection: Search for all update_cell() calls with column letters
Compare column letters used across all files
Verify they match the header structure
prevention: Create a single source of truth for column mappings
Use shared constants or helper functions
Verify all files use the same column references

lessons_learned: Always verify column indices match header structure before hardcoding
Never place critical code after continue/return statements
Use helper functions to derive column letters from header names
Test all conditional branches to ensure code executes
Create shared constants for column mappings across files
